summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of the Design page rebuild (five shared-slab 3D material samples, Pietra Grey stone copy, 16:9 mobile/tablet hero) plus a Contact-page hero spot-check. All requested behaviours passed: WebGL canvas renders on desktop 1440, tablet 768 and mobile 390; all five materials (walnut, stone, bronze, leather, smoked glass) render as one identical uninterrupted landscape slab at the same three-quarter angle with no seams, dividers, frames or hardware; tab clicks, mobile prev/next arrows and desktop scroll-spy all switch material with counter/name updates and correct arrow disabling at both ends; hero is exactly 1.78 ratio at 375/390/430/768 with zero horizontal overflow and unchanged (2.11 fixed crop) at 1440; stone copy matches the new ORIGIN/PATTERN/SURFACE/USED FOR text and no mention of Nero Portoro/Calacatta/Arabescato remains anywhere on the page; both interior photographs load (naturalWidth > 0); no JS/WebGL console errors (only benign 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' perf warnings caused by the test's own canvas screenshots). Contact hero is intact: left column CONTACT / Contact Nova / lead / divider / E-POSTA + TELEFON with the birds video in the right column at 1440, details before video at 390, no overflow.

issues: Aged bronze specimen reads as a very dark warm brown with little metallic response; at a glance its value is close to the walnut sample, so 'patinated bronze' is only weakly legible (subjective, brief-adjacent)
Pietra Grey slab reads as a warm greige/brown-grey rather than a clearly charcoal grey field; veining and mirroring are correct and restrained (subjective)

critical_code_review_comments: materials3d.js references studioCard inside show() before its const initialisation; it works today only because show(0) runs after the IIFE — a future reorder would throw a ReferenceError. Consider declaring studioCard above show().

Each of the 4 textured slabs creates 6 texture loads (face + edge map sets) lazily per material; acceptable, but the same tex-<slug> files are fetched twice per material (different repeat/offset objects). Sharing a THREE.Texture with cloned UV transforms would halve requests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Design page prev/next arrows (.dz-reg-nav) are display:none above 1100px by design (css/design.css:477, shown only in the <=1100px block at line 533), so arrow tests must run at <=1100px width — this is not a bug. Allow ~2.6-3s after each material switch (1.25s spin + 0.5s delayedCall before show()). Canvas screenshots via Playwright trigger harmless WebGL ReadPixels perf warnings; ignore them. Verified metrics: hero ratio 1.78 at 375/390/430/768, 2.11 at 1440; mobile canvas is full-bleed 390x292.5; scroll-spy keeps the floating stage inside .dz-reg-grid and clear of the copy column at all five entries.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects reproduced this round; the two items listed are subjective material-appearance notes, not functional failures.
